description.zh: 创建、定制和管理插件：脚手架、组件 schema（skills / agents / hooks / MCP）、连接器配置与模板适配。部分上游技能假设 Cowork 桌面环境，本地使用时按通用插件规范在工作区内输出。
description.en: Create, customize, and manage plugins: scaffolding, component schemas (skills / agents / hooks / MCP), connector configuration, and template adaptation. Some upstream skills assume the Cowork desktop environment; locally they deliver results as workspace files.

welcome_message.zh: 想为团队定制一个插件？从描述需求开始
welcome_message.en: Want a plugin tailored to your team? Start by describing the need
